source_annotation.image_caption: In the image, a muddy construction site is visible with tire tracks imprinted on the ground. Some metal sheets are paved on the ground. On the left side, there is a steep dirt embankment. Moving towards the center, there is a single worker standing in front of a yellow excavator that is positioned on a flat area with a dirt surface. On the right, a row of transmission tower and a row of street lamps can be observed above the trees and bushes.

In the foreground, there is a car parked on the left, and a green dump truck is loaded with soil on the right. To the right of the dump truck, a worker is standing next to a bulldozer. Piles of orange pipes are behind the bulldozer. In the background, an excavator is operating on a raised area of dirt to the left. Buildings and vegetation are visible in the far background.

An excavator is visible in the background, suggesting recent digging or earthmoving activity.
